blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.
blocks.zh: 计算机使用代理人(CUAs)正在迅速改进,但其评价基本上保持不变。 现有基准提供了坚实的基础,但有固定的困难上限、有限的特征覆盖面和粗糙的总分逐渐削弱了其歧视性和诊断性价值。 我们引入了CUA-SEE,这是一种封闭式评估环境,它共同将任务和可执行核查人从推出的证据中演化出来. 它分解了三个目标:基准演化通过组群校准难度和覆盖面增长来扩大评价范围;诊断演化通过代理-有条件的能力边界探测器来提高分辨率;核查演化通过将不断变化的要求转化为有对抗性的基于国家的检查站来提高精度。 CUA-SEE通过多种代理、应用和回合,产生具有挑战性、可计量的任务,同时保存流程层面的证据。 我们的成果将适应性评价定位为可扩展的自我演化剂的对应物,不断跟踪哪些物剂可以做,其界限在什么地方,如何可靠地衡量进展.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Agent evaluation, which underpins both scientific progress and real-world deployment, has long been a fundamentally yet challenging problem [ 6 , 21 , 14 , 11 ] .
For computer-use agents (CUAs) [ 8 , 10 , 19 , 23 ] , evaluation is harder because success must be verified against intricate software-specific states and multifaceted task requirements, rather than textual responses (e.g., search agents [ 9 , 7 , 2 ] ) or binary execution results (e.g., code agents [ 5 ] ).
Current benchmarks [ 18 , 20 ] have established an essential foundation for CUA evaluation by manually curating realistic tasks and task-specific verifiers.
However, this human-authored, one-shot construction paradigm is costly to scale and renders both tasks and verifiers largely fixed as agent capabilities evolve, giving rise to several critical limitations [ 17 , 4 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh:
代理评价是科学进步和现实世界部署的基础,长期以来是一个根本而具有挑战性的问题[6、21、14、11]。
对于计算机使用代理人(CUAs)[8,10,19,23],评价比较困难,因为必须根据复杂的软件特定状态和多方面的任务要求来核实成功与否,而不是文字反应(例如搜索代理人[9,7,2])或二进制执行结果(例如代码代理人[5]).
目前的基准[18, 20]为海关总署通过人工管理现实的任务和具体任务的核查员,为评价奠定了重要的基础。
然而,这种由人授权的一发一发的建筑范式在规模化方面代价高昂,使任务和核查器都随着代理能力的发展而基本固定下来,从而产生了若干关键的限制[17、4、22]。

blocks.en:
This static paradigm creates three consequential limitations: (1) A fixed task set imposes a difficulty ceiling : once agents master its tasks, scores saturate and cease to distinguish further progress. (2) Manual construction provides limited feature coverage ; in our audit of core OSWorld applications, the existing tasks exercise less than 20% of the available software-feature taxonomy. (3) Static benchmarks lack evaluation dynamics : they neither track a moving capability boundary nor actively search for newly emerging weaknesses, shortcut behaviors, and generalization gaps.
These limitations reveal the necessity of an evaluation system that evolves in tandem with the LLM agents it assesses.
blocks.zh:
这种静态模式产生了三个相应的限制: (1) 一套固定的任务规定了一个难度上限:一旦代理人掌握了任务,便得分饱和并不再区分进一步的进展。 (2) 人工构造提供有限的特性覆盖面;在我们对OSWorld核心应用的审计中,现有任务进行的软件特性分类工作不到现有软件特性分类的20%。 (3)静态基准缺乏评价动态:它们既不跟踪移动能力界限,也不积极寻找新出现的弱点、捷径行为和概括差距。
这些限制表明,有必要建立一个与其评估的LLM代理人同步发展的评价系统。

blocks.en:
To address the aforementioned challenges, we propose CUA-SEE , a S elf- E volving E valuation environment for computer-use agents.
CUA-SEE reconceptualizes evaluation as a dynamic, closed-loop process where tasks, executable verifiers, and agent rollout evidence continuously inform and refine one another.
At each round, agents interact with the current task-verifier pairs; validity-filtered trajectories and checkpoint outcomes update the measurement state; and this evidence determines what tasks should be measured in the next round and how the corresponding verifiers should be implemented.
Specifically, our framework is designed around three core components that work in concert to disentangle three dimensions often conflated in conventional task-hardening pipelines: evaluation scope, diagnostic resolution, and measurement precision .
blocks.zh:
为了应对上述挑战,我们提议为计算机使用代理人提供一个S精灵-E伏克E估值环境。
CUA-SEE将评价重新构思为一个动态的、闭锁的流程,在这些流程中,任务、可执行核查人和代理人推出的证据不断相互通报和完善。
在每轮中,代理人与当前任务核查者对等进行交互;有效性过滤的轨迹和检查结果更新了测量状态;而这种证据决定了下一轮中应当测量哪些任务以及应当如何执行相应的核查者.
具体地说,我们的框架围绕三个核心组成部分设计,这些核心组成部分协同工作,将三个层面分解开来:评价范围、诊断分辨率和测量精确度。

blocks.en:
Scope. To address the fixed difficulty ceiling and feature coverage, we expand the evaluation scope of static benchmarks by introducing an evolution operator, called Benchmark Task Evolution , which constructs a shared, model-neutral benchmark from aligned trajectories of a heterogeneous agent cohort.
It retains all replicates, separates execution validity from task success, and uses cohort agreement and disagreement to calibrate whether a source task is mastered, discriminating, unstable, or confounded.
Evolution then optimizes two suite-level objectives: advancing the measurable difficulty frontier and expanding coverage over exact software-feature-operation cells and capability-intensity cells. Candidate descendants may increase precision, scale, state dependence, procedure depth, feature composition, or add a previously uncovered but coherent operation.
Each descendant preserves a semantic lineage anchor and must introduce explicit, independently observable measurement obligations, while a round-level registry coordinates coverage growth across tasks. Benchmark evolution thus broadens what the suite can measure without tailoring the benchmark to an idiosyncratic failure of one agent.
blocks.zh:
范围。 为了解决固定难度上限和特征覆盖面问题,我们扩大了静态基准的评价范围,引入了一个称为 " 基准任务演变 " 的演化操作员,该操作员从不同物剂群的一致轨迹中构建出一个共同的、模式中立的基准。
它保留了所有复制品,将执行有效性与任务成功区分开来,并使用组团协议和分歧来校正一个源任务是否被掌握,是否被歧视,是否不稳定,或者是否被混淆.
然后演化优化了两个套件级目标:推进可测量难度前沿,并扩展覆盖范围,超越精确的软件地物操作细胞和能力强度细胞. 候选人的后人可能提高精确度、规模、状态依赖性、程序深度、特征构成,或增加以前发现的、但一致的操作。
每个后人都保留了语义分界线锚地,必须引入明确、独立可观察的测量义务,而圆形登记册则协调各项任务的覆盖范围增长。 因此,基准的演变扩大了套房可以计量的内容,而不必调整基准以适应一个代理人的特异性失败。

blocks.en:
Resolution. The second operator, called Diagnostic Task Evolution , is agent-conditional and concentrates evaluation budget near uncertain capability boundaries.
A batch-level planner aggregates longitudinal evidence into capability, software, and feature maps to dispatch targeted experiments over seven calibrated dimensions such as precision control and state-dependent reasoning, as detailed in Appendix A .
The task-level evolver realizes each experiment as a natural task with one primary dimension at a controlled intensity.
The search is adaptive rather than monotonically harder:
Clean successes and failures prompt upward and downward probes, respectively; partial or censored runs trigger deconfounding.
This adaptive bracketing refines where an agent’s pass-fail transition lies, turning coarse benchmark scores into locally attributable capability evidence.
blocks.zh:
决议。 第二个操作者称为诊断任务进化,具有代理条件,将评价预算集中在不确定的能力界限附近。
如附录A所详述的,一个批量级规划人员将纵向证据汇总到能力、软件和特征图中,以便在精确控制和国家依赖性推理等七个校正维度上进行有针对性的实验。
任务级演化器将每个实验都视为一项自然任务,在受控强度下具有一个主维.
搜索是适应性的,而不是单调的更难:
干净的成功和失败分别促使上下调查;部分或审查的运行引发混乱。
这种适应性的分层方式改进了代理商的过错过渡之处,将粗糙的基准分数转化为当地可归属的能力证据。

blocks.en:
Precision. Both task operators share a requirement-preserving measurement backbone, termed as Verifier Evolution .
The third component uses task-agnostic software adapters to probe native state-export surfaces and normalize them into a shared CanonicalState schema. Over this substrate, an information-isolated verifier agent generates atomic requirement-level checkpoints while a pass agent independently realizes a valid completion state; their adversarial cross-review improves checkpoint completeness and PRE/PASS discrimination [ 12 , 16 ] . Verifier evolution thus determines how faithfully evolving agent behavior is measured while exposing process-level signals for diagnosis and future dense-feedback learning.
blocks.zh:
精细. 两个任务操作员共享一个保留要求的测量主干线,称为验证器演化.
第三个部分使用任务不可知软件适配器来探测原生国-出口地表并使它们正常化为共享的Canonical State schema. 在这个底板上,一个信息同化的核查人员产生原子要求一级的检查站,而通过人员独立地实现有效的完成状态;他们的对抗性交叉审查提高了检查站的完整性和PRE/PAS的歧视[12、16]。 因此,验证器演化决定了如何在暴露用于诊断和未来密集反馈学习的流程级信号的同时,忠实地测量演化的代理行为。

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments across five SOTA agents demonstrate that CUA-SEE continuously restores evaluation informativeness. Over four evolution rounds, the macro-average agent score decreases from 60.6 to 47.5 while trajectory length increases from 27.4 to 39.3 steps, and exact feature coverage expands by 3.65 × \times .
Beyond producing harder and broader tasks, CUA-SEE adaptively concentrates diagnostic probes near each agent’s capability boundary, revealing agent-specific and software-specific weaknesses obscured by aggregate scores.
Meanwhile, the evolved checkpoint verifiers achieve 84.0% agreement with human trajectory judgments.
To summarize, our main contributions are: 1. We formulate self-evolving evaluation for CUAs as a closed loop in which task demand, measurement instruments, and validity-filtered rollout evidence are updated jointly across rounds, addressing the mismatch between continually improving agents and static benchmarks. 2. We introduce two complementary task-evolution operators: a cohort-grounded benchmark operator that expands evaluation scope through measurable frontier and feature-coverage growth, and an agent-conditional diagnostic operator that increases resolution through controlled, adaptive capability-boundary probes. 3. We develop a requirement-preserving verifier evolution pipeline that improves measurement precision by converting evolved task obligations into executable, state-grounded checkpoints, enabling validity-aware capability estimation and richer process supervision than terminal scalar rewards alone.
blocks.zh:
5种SOTA剂的广泛实验表明,CUA-SEE持续恢复评价信息. 在4个进化回合中,宏观平均剂分从60.6分下降到47.5分,而轨迹长度从27.4分增加到39.3分,准确的地物覆盖范围扩大了3.65×\时.
CUA-SEE除了产生更难和更广泛的任务外,还适应性地将诊断探测器集中在每个代理的能力界限附近,揭示出特定代理和软件的弱点,这些弱点被总分所掩盖。
同时,经过演变的检查站核查员与人类的轨迹判断达成了84.0%的一致。
总之,我们的主要贡献是: 1. 我们为海关总署制定自发评价,将其作为一个封闭的循环,在这种循环中,对任务需求、计量仪器和有效性过滤的推出证据进行联合更新,解决不断改进剂与静态基准之间的不匹配问题。 2. 我们引入了两个互补的任务演进操作员:一个基于组群的基准操作员,通过可测量的前沿和地物覆盖增长扩大评价范围;另一个代理条件诊断操作员,通过可控的适应能力边界探测器提高分辨率。 3. 我们开发了一个保留要求的核查器演化管道,通过将已演变的任务义务转化为可执行的、有国家依据的检查站,从而改进测量精度,从而能够对有效性作出了解能力估计并进行比终端分级奖励更丰富的流程监督。

blocks.en:
While popular benchmarks like OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena [ 18 , 1 , 15 ] offer robust, reproducible evaluation of computer-use agents in real desktop environments, they are limited to a fixed set of pre-curated tasks.
As agent capability improves, extending such benchmarks by hand is costly, difficult to scale, and slow to expose new capability limits.
Recent systems automate parts of this process: CUA-Gym [ 12 ] generates verifiable task-state-reward tuples, while OpenComputer [ 16 ] builds tasks with state verifiers and partial-credit rewards.
Their main goal, however, is to scale verifiable environments or training data rather than repeatedly adapt a benchmark to the observed behavior of a fixed agent.
blocks.zh:
虽然OSWorld和WindowsAgentArena[18, 1, 15]等流行基准为真实桌面环境中的计算机使用代理提供了稳健,可复制的评价,但它们仅限于一套固定的预测任务.
随着代理能力的提高,手工延长这种基准是昂贵的,难以扩大规模,也难以暴露出新的能力限制。
最近的系统自动化了这个过程的部分: CUA-Gym [12] 生成可核查的任务状态奖励拖拉机,而OpenComputer [16] 则与状态验证器构建任务和部分信用奖励.
然而,它们的主要目标是扩大可核查的环境或培训数据,而不是再三调整一个基准以适应被观察到的固定剂的行为。

blocks.en:
Early efforts have begun to explore benchmark evolution through rule-based editing, scheduled data refreshes, and agent-driven exploration [ 13 , 17 , 6 ] .
AutoEvoEval applies predefined transformations to reasoning or question-answering tasks, while EvoCodeBench periodically adds new code tasks.
Most closely related, TRACE [ 3 ] uses test-time exploration to generate progressively harder web-search tasks and verify their solutions for reproducibility.
Unlike our approach, however, TRACE’s scope is limited to task difficulty, and it leaves the critical role of verifier evolution unaddressed by employing a static, exact-match verifier.
blocks.zh:
早期工作已经开始通过基于规则的编辑、预定的数据更新和代理人驱动的探索[13、17、6]探索基准的演变。
AutoEvoEval对推理或问答任务应用了预先定义的转换,而EvoCode Bench则定期添加新的代码任务.
最密切相关的是,TRACE[3]利用测试时间探索,生成出越来越困难的网络搜索任务并验证其解决方案,以便复制.
然而,与我们的方法不同,TRACE的范围仅限于任务难度,它通过使用一个静态的,精确匹配的核查器,使核查员进化的关键作用得不到解决.

blocks.en: 3.1 Scope: Benchmark Task Evolution
blocks.zh: 3.1 范围: 基准任务演变

blocks.en: Benchmark task evolution expands the population-level scope of evaluation. Given source tasks, aligned trajectories from a heterogeneous agent cohort, and the accumulated coverage registry, it produces a model-neutral batch of task descendants that advances the measurable difficulty frontier and enlarges the set of capabilities and software operations covered by the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 基准任务的演变扩大了人口一级的评价范围。 鉴于源任务、来自不同代理人组群的一致轨迹以及累积的覆盖范围登记册,它产生了一批不带模型的任务,从而推进了可衡量的困难前沿,扩大了基准所涵盖的一套能力和软件操作。

blocks.en:
We join trajectories by canonical source-task identity and retain every compatible replicate. Evidence integrity is modeled independently of task outcome: valid successes and failures provide clean evidence, step-limit runs are retained as censored observations, and setup, controller, or environment failures are marked as invalid. Using scores, termination states, checkpoint transitions, regressions, and path diversity, we classify each source lineage as universally easy, mostly mastered, discriminating, universally hard, unstable, or confounded.
This cohort-level state determines the admissible strength of evolution while preventing transient or model-specific errors from becoming benchmark objectives.
blocks.zh:
我们通过Canonical的源任务身份加入轨道,并保留所有相容的复制. 证据完整性是独立于任务结果的模型:有效的成功和失败提供了干净的证据,步骤限制运行被保留为被审查的观察,设置,控制器或环境故障被标记为无效. 我们利用分数、终止状态、检查站过渡、回归和路径多样性,将每个源系归类为普遍容易、大多掌握、歧视、普遍困难、不稳定或困惑。
这种组位状态决定了进化的可接受强度,同时防止瞬间或模型特定出错成为基准目标.

blocks.en: Evolution jointly optimizes difficulty-frontier and feature-coverage growth at the round level. Difficulty growth requires a measurable increase in one or more calibrated capability demands without material regression of the overall task, whereas coverage growth requires a strict set addition on either the exact software-taxonomy-operation surface or the capability-intensity surface. Required action families are tracked separately as exposure rather than treated as agent capabilities. A shared lineage and coverage registry coordinates parallel workers and prevents repeated references to an already measured feature from being counted as new breadth. Individual tasks may specialize in difficulty or coverage, but the selected batch must advance both objectives in aggregate.
blocks.zh: 进化联合优化了回合级难度-前沿和地貌-覆盖增长. 难以增长需要可计量地增加一个或多个校正能力需求,而不使总体任务发生实质性回落,而覆盖范围增长则需要严格地在准确的软件-分类-操作表面或能力强度表面增加。 所需行动家庭作为接触物单独跟踪,而不是作为剂能处理。 共享的分界线和覆盖范围登记册协调平行的工人,防止重复提及已经测量过的特征被算作新的宽度。 个别任务可能专门涉及难度或覆盖面,但所选定的批次必须综合推进两个目标。

blocks.en:
For each eligible source, we construct candidates with four directions: difficulty escalation , coverage expansion , transfer with measurable escalation , and their coherent combination . Every candidate preserves a lineage anchor, the semantic demand that makes cross-round comparison meaningful, while allowing values, targets, scale, context, and supporting subgoals to change.
Purely horizontal transfer is excluded: a transferred task must introduce an independently measurable demand or coverage cell. Candidates may increase precision, dependence, procedural depth, or verification requirements, but unrelated feature grafts and superficial elaboration do not constitute evolution.
blocks.zh:
对于每个符合条件的来源,我们构建了四个方向的候选者:困难升级、覆盖面扩大、可衡量升级的转移及其协调一致的组合。 每个候选人都保留了分界线锚地,语义要求使跨回合比较有意义,同时允许价值观、目标、规模、背景和支持次级目标的变化。
纯横向转移被排除在外:被转移的任务必须引入独立可测量的需求或覆盖单元. 候选人可能提高准确性、依赖性、程序深度或核查要求,但不相关的特征转移和表面阐述不构成演变。

blocks.en:
A candidate is eligible only if it preserves the lineage anchor, avoids material difficulty regression, remains feasible within the interaction budget, admits a uniquely observable final state, and is justified by model-neutral evidence. Eligible candidates are ranked by feasibility, verifiability, calibrated difficulty, coverage gain, model neutrality, and naturalness; step requirements above 0.85 0.85 of the available budget are rejected.
The output remains a general benchmark task proposal until every evolved obligation is instantiated by an executable verifier.
blocks.zh:
候选人只有在保留了分系锚地,避免了重大困难回归,在互动预算范围内仍然可行,承认独有可观察的最终状态,并且有模型中性证据证明的情况下,才有资格获得资格. 符合资格的候选人按可行性、可核查性、校准难度、覆盖率增益、模式中立性和自然性排列;现有预算0.85 0.85以上的步骤要求被拒绝。
产出仍然是一般的基准任务建议,直到每个演变后的义务都由可执行核查人立即提出。

blocks.en: 3.2 Resolution: Diagnostic Task Evolution
blocks.zh: 3.2 决议:诊断任务的演变

blocks.en:
Diagnostic task evolution increases the resolution of evaluation around an individual agent’s capability boundary.
This multi-agent system follows a hierarchical process: a batch-level planner converts longitudinal rollout evidence into agent-specific diagnostic dispatches, and a per-task evolver realizes each dispatch as a controlled task proposal.
The objective is not maximal difficulty or scope (i.e., Benchmark Evolution), but a locally attributable observation that narrows the agent’s pass-fail boundary.
blocks.zh:
诊断性任务的演变使评价围绕单个物剂的能力界限进行。
这种多剂系统遵循了分级过程:一个分批级计划员将纵向推开证据转换为特有剂诊断调度,每个任务演化员实现每次调度都是作为可控任务提案.
目标不是最大难度或范围(即基准演化),而是当地可归属的、缩小代理人通过失败界限的观察。

blocks.en:
To allocate well-targeted dispatches, the batch planner first separates pass, partial, confounded, and invalid outcomes, using only observations with valid setup and verifiers as clean boundary evidence.
It then aggregates multiple analytical views to identify stable, failing, or insufficiently supported regions.
Each dispatch targets a diagnostic cell defined by software, feature, primary capability, and intensity, together with control dimensions and confound limits.
Priority is given to deconfounding blocked evidence, resolving uncertain transitions, testing transfer of suspected weaknesses, expanding under-supported cells, and replicating non-monotonic results.
blocks.zh:
为了分配目标明确的调度,批发计划人员首先会分出通过,部分,曲折,无效的结果,只使用带有有效设置和验证器的观测作为干净的边界证据.
然后,它综合了多种分析观点,以确定稳定、失败或支助不足的区域。
每次发送都针对一个由软件、特性、初级能力和强度定义的诊断细胞,以及控制尺寸和混乱的限度。
优先解析被阻断的证据,解决不确定的过渡,检测疑似薄弱环节的转移,扩大支持不足的细胞,并复制非模拟结果.

blocks.en:
For one dispatched source lineage, the task evolver constructs a local neighborhood of candidates: the requested intensity, a cleaner lower-intensity fallback, and, when feasible, an adjacent higher-intensity or alternate-factor probe.
Each task is defined by a primary demand dimension and several secondary dimensions, all drawn from the 7D capabilities: scale consistency, precision control, target grounding, state-dependent reasoning, procedure following, feature integration, or verification and control . Intensities are scored from 0 to 5 using dimension-specific factors derived from the instruction, initial state, and verifier obligations; they describe task demand rather than predicted agent performance (detailed in Appendix A ).
blocks.zh:
对于一个被发送源系,任务演化器会构建一个本地的候选区:所请求的强度,更清洁的低强度回落,并在可行时,相邻的更高强度或相接因素探测器.
每项任务由主要需求层面和几个次要层面界定,这些层面都取自7D能力:规模一致性、精确控制、目标地基、国家依赖推理、遵循的程序、特征整合或核查和控制。 强度通过指令、初始状态和核查义务产生的维度特定因素得到从0到5的分数;它们描述的是任务需求,而不是预测的代理性能(详见附录A)。

blocks.en:
The probe direction is evidence-driven rather than assumed to be monotonically upward.
Clean passes or failures adjust intensity upward or downward, respectively, while ambiguous results trigger corrective actions like deconfounding, simplification, or replication.
Each proposal records expected failure modes and explicit verifier requirements, and it updates the agent’s capability boundary only after verifier evolution and a valid rollout make the resulting evidence eligible.
blocks.zh:
探测方向由证据驱动,而不是假设是单调向上.
干净的通道或故障分别向上或向下调整强度,而模棱两可的结果则触发了诸如分解、简化或复制等纠正行动。
每一份提案都记录预期失败模式和明确的核查要求,只有在核查者演变和有效推出使由此产生的证据符合条件之后,才能更新代理人的能力界限。

blocks.en:
Capability demand is factorized from nuisance variables including step budget, context load and verifier risk. Candidates that violate dispatch limits, exceed the step budget, or lack an observable outcome are redesigned or rejected.
Remaining ones are ranked by dispatch alignment, diagnostic cleanliness, secondary coverage value, etc.
This criterion deliberately favors a slightly weaker but cleanly attributable probe over a harder task which cannot resolve agent boundaries.
blocks.zh:
能力需求从包括分步预算、上下文负荷和核实风险在内的有害变量中考虑。 违反调度限制、超过分级预算或缺乏可观察结果的候选人将重新设计或拒绝。
其余的按调度对接,诊断清洁,二级覆盖值等进行排名.
这一标准有意倾向于稍弱但可归属的探测器,而不是解决代理人界限的更艰巨的任务。

blocks.en: 3.3 Precision: Unified Verifier Evolution
blocks.zh: 3.3 精度:统一验证

blocks.en:
Verifier evolution co-evolves the measurement instrument with each task so that increased task demand remains faithfully observable.
The objective is to maximize coverage of the evolved task contract while preserving verifier lineage, grounding every check in observable state, and explicitly representing verification gaps.
blocks.zh:
验证器演化使测量仪器与每项任务共同演化,从而能够忠实地观察到任务需求的增加。
目的是尽量扩大已发展的任务合同的涵盖范围,同时保留核查的分界线,使每一项检查都处于可观察状态,并明确代表核查差距。

blocks.en: We reconstruct the evolved task contract as a set of independently testable outcome requirements derived from the explicit evaluator requirements and atomic clauses of the instruction. Target values, ordering constraints, artifact states, preservation conditions, and prohibited side effects are retained as first-class obligations rather than silently omitted or merged into coarse success criteria.
blocks.zh: 我们把演变中的任务合同重建为一套独立可测试的结果要求,这些要求源自指令中明确的评价要求和原子条款。 目标值、订购限制、文物状态、保存条件和被禁副作用被保留为一等义务,而不是默默地省略或并入粗糙的成功标准。

State paths must be supported by the application’s state catalog or captured snapshots; proxy checks based only on file existence, filenames, setup state, or unavailable pre-action values are disallowed. Unsupported clauses remain explicit coverage gaps rather than unsound surrogates, avoiding selection bias against complex, harder-to-inspect applications that discarding such tasks would introduce.

blocks.en:
Given the source verifier, each existing checkpoint receives an explicit lineage operation: Keep for an unchanged obligation, Modify for a changed target or expected value, and Remove for an obligation absent from the evolved task; Add introduces checkpoints for newly required effects.
The original OSWorld evaluator may provide semantic evidence about intended facts, tolerances, and conjunction structure, but the evolved task contract remains authoritative. Optional trajectories and checkpoint histories are used to confirm state paths and expose regressions, while an individual failed rollout is not treated as sufficient evidence of verifier error.
blocks.zh:
鉴于来源核查人,每个现有检查站都得到明确的分界线操作: 保持债务不变,根据改变的目标或预期值修改债务,并因任务变化而取消债务; 添加为新需要的效果设置检查站。
最初的OSWorld评价者可能提供有关预期事实,容受度,和并联结构的语义学证据,但演化后的任务合同仍然具有权威性. 可选的轨迹和检查站历史被用来确认状态路径并揭露回归,而个别失败的推出则不被视为验证错误的充分证据.

blocks.en:
To construct a verifier, each software is equipped with a task-agnostic adapter that probes native state-export interfaces (e.g., debug protocols) to extract and normalize its snapshot into a shared CanonicalState schema.
The transformed contract is compiled into distinct schema-grounded checkpoints, each of which checks one task effect and returns a specific expected-versus-actual reason. Every requirement must map to a checkpoint or be declared as an explicit observability gap, prohibiting shortcuts like unconditional passes or inference-based fallbacks.
A partially observable task remains rollout-ready when at least one meaningful target effect is soundly verified and all omissions are declared.
blocks.zh:
为了构建一个验证器,每个软件都配备了任务不可知的适配器,可以探测出本土的国-出口接口(例如调试协议)来取出快照并将其正常化,形成一个共享的Canonical State schema.
改订的合同编成不同的设点检查站,每个检查站检查一个任务效果,并返回具体的预期与实际原因。 每一项要求都必须绘制到检查站地图,或被宣布为明显的可观察漏洞,禁止诸如无条件通行证或基于推论的倒计时等捷径.
当至少一个有意义的目标效果得到可靠核实并宣布所有遗漏时,部分可观察的任务仍然可以展开。

blocks.en:
Validation separates three static gates (i.e., syntax and imports, structural contract, and static schema), from two behavioral gates (i.e., PRE/PASS discrimination and checkpoint-wise negative fixtures).
An information-isolated pass agent independently realizes an executable PASS state and audits checkpoint necessity and completeness, while a verifier agent audits whether that state genuinely satisfies the task without access to the pass implementation. Their adversarial cross-review exposes trivial checkpoints, missing obligations, and incorrect expected values. Revisions are adopted only when they preserve task semantics and do not reduce the best validated verifier score.
blocks.zh:
验证将三个静态门(即语法和进口、结构合同和静态计划)与两个行为门(即PRE/PASS歧视和检查站负面固定装置)分开。
信息隔离的通过代理人独立实现一个可执行的PASS状态,并审计检查站的必要性和完整性,而核查代理人则审计该状态是否在不接触通过实施的情况下真正完成任务。 它们的对抗性交叉审查暴露出微不足道的检查站、缺失的义务和不正确的预期价值。 修订只有在保留了任务语义时才被采用,并且不会减少最经过验证的核查员分数.

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluations on Evolved Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.1 对演变中的基准的评价

blocks.en:
As summarized in Table 2 , we conclude the following:
(1) The evolved benchmark becomes substantially more demanding.
Across all five agents, the macro-average score decreases from 60.6 in R ​ 1 R1 to 47.5 in R ​ 4 R4 , while the average trajectory length increases from 27.4 to 39.3 steps.
(2)
Kimi, Qwen, and GPT obtain slightly higher scores in R ​ 2 R2 than in R ​ 1 R1 ; nevertheless, their trajectory lengths increase by 9.5, 4.6, and 5.8 steps, respectively. This indicates that later tasks generally require longer interaction chains, while newly introduced features may align better with the capabilities of particular agents.
(3) Difficulty growth is uneven across applications. Chrome remains comparatively easy in later rounds, whereas GIMP, Calc, and Writer exhibit larger score reductions.
blocks.zh:
如表2所概述,我们的结论是:
(1) 不断演变的基准要求要高得多。
在所有五个代理商中,宏观平均分从R 1 R1的60.6分降至R 4 R4的47.5分,而平均轨迹长度从27.4步增至39.3步.
(二)
Kimi,Quen,和GPT在R2R2中得分略高于R1R1;然而,他们的轨迹长度分别增加了9.5,4.6和5.8步. 这表明后期任务一般需要较长的互动链,而新引入的特性可能更能与特定代理的能力相配合.
(3) 各应用程序之间困难的增长不平衡。 Chrome在后几轮中仍然相对容易,而GIMP,Calc,和Writer则表现出较大的分数减少.

Feature coverage is organized hierarchically from broad feature families, through finer-grained feature categories, to exact executable feature operations within each software.
(1) The results in Table 3 also demonstrate a consistent and hierarchical expansion of functional coverage across successive evolution rounds, with steady growth in feature families and categories and a 3.65 × 3.65\times increase in exact feature operations by R ​ 4 R4 .

总的来说,这些结果证实,迭接基准的演变系统地扩大了基准的功能和业务范围,而不仅仅是重写现有任务。

blocks.en:
Beyond difficulty and coverage metrics, the evolved tasks exhibit a rich, multi-faceted structure, with detailed statistics shown in Figure 5 .
(1) The tasks exhibit compound capability demands, with procedure following and target grounding frequently required at moderate-to-high intensities.
(2) Capability profiles vary substantially across applications—for example, Calc emphasizes precision control, whereas Chrome and VLC place greater demands on target grounding—demonstrating software-specific rather than templated difficulty.
(3) Finally, the suite covers diverse interaction families, spanning clicks, text, keyboard shortcuts, and long-tail operations such as scrolling and dragging.
blocks.zh:
除了困难和覆盖度衡量标准外,不断演变的任务还呈现出丰富多彩的结构,详细统计数据见图5。
(1) 任务需要复合能力,经常需要以中等至高强度的程序和目标入地。
(2) 不同应用程序的能力剖面差别很大——例如,Calc强调精确控制,而Chrome和VLC则对目标搁浅提出了更大的要求——演示软件特有的而不是模板化的困难。
(3)最后,套接字包涵盖了多种交互家族,横跨点击,文字,键盘快捷键,以及滚动和拖放等长尾操作.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evolved Diagnoses of Specific Agents
blocks.zh: 4.2 对特定物剂的变化分析

blocks.en:
(1) Figure 2 reveals that our Diagnostic Evolution continually mines the agent’s pass/fail boundary, thereby shifting the original saturated benchmark from near-universal success toward a more informative regime where nuanced diagnosis becomes possible.
(2) Our method diagnoses heterogeneous capabilities and distinct software-specific strengths that are typically obscured by aggregate scores. As visualized in Figure 7 and Supplementary Figures 13 and 13 , this analysis reveals unique performance signatures for each agent across various diagnostic matrices, such as capability-intensity and software-feature.
(3) Successive rounds expand coverage across capability, software, function, and action dimensions. Each round consistently introduces 57–73 new feature leaves, ensuring that our diagnosis grows in breadth and is not merely resampling similar challenges.
blocks.zh:
(1) 图2显示,我们的诊断演进不断破坏毒剂的通关/失效边界,从而将最初的饱和基准从几乎普遍的成功转向一个信息更加丰富的制度,从而有可能进行细微的诊断。
(2) 我们的方法分析不同的能力和不同的软件特有优势,这些优势通常被总分所掩盖。 如图7和补充图13和13所示,这一分析显示,在各种诊断矩阵中,如能力强度和软件特性,每种剂都有独特的性能特征。
(3) 连续几轮扩大涵盖能力、软件、功能和行动层面。 每轮都不断推出57-73个新特征叶子,确保我们的诊断范围扩大,而不仅仅是重复类似的挑战。

blocks.en:
Based on the diagnosis, we construct specific agent profiles.
(1) Capability: Gemini is strong in precision control and target grounding, but high-scale consistency remains challenging.
(2) Operation: Kimi is reliable on clicking, typing, and navigation, while Seed is more sensitive to dragging, scrolling, and state-dependent controls.
(3) Feature: Kimi shows the most consistent feature-level performance, whereas Seed varies more across document and media features.
(4) Software: All three agents are more stable in Chrome and VS Code, while GIMP and Thunderbird expose clearer weaknesses.
blocks.zh:
根据诊断,我们构建了特定的毒剂剖面。
(1)能力:双子星在精密控制和目标地平面上很强,但高尺度一致性仍然具有挑战性.
(2)操作:Kimi在点击,打字,和导航方面是可靠的,而种子对拖放,滚动,和状态依赖的控制更敏感.
(3)地物:Kimi表现出最一致地地地物级性能,而种子则因文档和媒体地物而异.
(4)软件:在Chrome和VS代码中,这三种代理都比较稳定,而GIMP和雷鸟则暴露出更清晰的弱点.

blocks.en: 4.3 Validation of Evolved Verifiers
blocks.zh: 4.3 演化验证人的验证

blocks.en:
We manually assess convergent validity on 400 Kimi trajectories across four evolution rounds in Figure 10 .
Human judgments and checkpoint verifiers agree on 84.0% of runs (Cohen’s κ = 0.640 \kappa=0.640 ), with agreement increasing from 81% to 89%. Continuous scores also show moderate concordance.
Audited disagreements mainly arise from incomplete adapter state, partial verifier coverage, and state-field mismatches, highlighting the remaining observability limitations.
blocks.zh:
我们手动评估400个基米轨迹的趋同有效性,
人类判断和检查站核查员同意84.0%的运行(Cohen = 0.640\kappa=0.640),协议从81%增加到89%。 连续分数也显示出中度相和.
经审计的分歧主要出自适配器状态不完全,部分核查覆盖,以及州域不匹配,凸显出其余可观察性限制.

blocks.en: Figure 8 and Supplementary Figure 12 confirm that evolved verifiers stay tightly aligned with growing task contracts rather than collapsing into minimal checks. Across 962 tasks (4.82 checkpoints/task), atomic requirement coverage reaches 92.5% overall—exceeding 85% in nearly all apps, with lower coverage isolated to native-adapter limits (e.g., Thunderbird). Moreover, checkpoint counts track requirement counts along the y = x y\!=\!x diagonal ( r = 0.55 ​ – ​ 0.65 r\!=\!0.55\text{--}0.65 ), with Partial tasks still grounding 3–7 checkpoints; the independent trajectory audit (Figure 10 ) further validates behavioral precision.

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation Reliability and Evolution Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价可靠性和演变效率

blocks.en:
Under live-VM budget and native observability limits, cross-round and cross-agent comparisons remain fair and discriminative:
(1) Out-of-cohort generalization: held-out Qwen ( − 26.9 -26.9 ) and GPT ( − 24.0 -24.0 ) match the cohort’s difficulty progression without driving evolution.
(2) Calibrated co-evolution: Keep / Modify inheritance, isolated PASS-state solvability gates, rising human agreement ( 81 % 81\% to 89 % 89\% ), verifier-independent 2 × 2\times step, and 2 – 3.5 × 2\text{--}3.5\times token growth rule out verifier drift.
(3) Partial-verifier symmetry: retaining sound Partial verifiers preserves hard-to-inspect apps while applying identical checks across all agents without artificial score deflation.
(4) Structured discrimination: while low R ​ 4 R4 pass rates ( 13 ​ – ​ 19 % 13\text{--}19\% ) narrow the macro spread, continuous scores lift boundary informativeness ( + 20.8 +20.8 pp to 69.7 69.7 ) and expose 20 ​ – ​ 37 20\text{--}37 pp per-app rank reversals masked by scalar means.
blocks.zh:
根据现场核查和监测机制的预算和本土的可观察性限制,交叉和交叉物剂比较仍然是公平和歧视性的:
(1) 离合通论:被搁置的Quen(−26.9-26.9)和GPT(−24.0-24.0)在不驱动进化的情况下与组群的难度相匹配.
(2)校正同化: 保留/ 修改继承, 孤立的 PASS 状态溶解门, 人类协议上升( 81 % 81 % 至 89 % 89 % ) , 校验者- 独立 2 — 2 — 时间步, 2 — 3.5 — 2\ text{ — } 3. 5\ 时间的象征性增长排除了校验者漂移。
(3)部分校验对称:保留声音部分校验者保留了难以被检查的应用软件,同时对所有代理机构实行相同的检查,而不会人为的分数通缩.
(4)结构化歧视:虽然低R 4 R4的通过率(13–19 % 13\text{-}19\%)缩小了宏观传播范围,但连续分数提升出边界信息度(+20.8+20.8页为69.7 69.7页)并揭露出20–37 20\text{-}37页每个应用的分级倒置被scalar手段所掩盖.

blocks.en: In Figure 10 , we measure the token usage and API-equivalent cost of successful task and verifier evolution runs, aggregated across rounds for three diagnostic agents and the multi-agent benchmark. Costs are estimated from cached input, uncached input, and output tokens using GPT-5.5 API rates. Verifier evolution exhibits stable costs across agents, while benchmark task evolution is more expensive due to its larger shared context, indicating that context construction—not verifier generation—is the primary efficiency bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 在图10中,我们衡量成功任务和核查器演化的象征性使用和API等同成本,并按不同轮次汇总了三种诊断剂和多剂基准。 费用估计来自缓存输入、未加注输入以及使用GPT-5.5 API率的输出符号。 验证器演化显示各种代理人的成本稳定,而基准任务演化则因其更大的共同背景而更为昂贵,这表明环境构造——而不是验证器生成——是主要的效率瓶颈。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation framework that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from computer-use agent trajectories. Benchmark evolution expands difficulty and coverage, diagnostic evolution probes agent-conditional capability boundaries, and verifier evolution grounds changing requirements in audited checkpoints. Experiments across agents, applications, and rounds show that adaptive evaluation remains informative beyond static benchmarks while producing attributable capability evidence. These results establish evolving evaluation as a practical counterpart to increasingly capable, self-evolving agents.
blocks.zh: 我们提出CUA-SEE,这是一个封闭式评估框架,它共同从计算机使用剂的轨迹演变出任务和可执行核查器。 基准演化扩大了难度和覆盖面,诊断演化探索了代理-有条件的能力界限,核查员演化为在被审计检查站改变要求的理由。 跨物剂、应用和轮回的实验表明,适应性评价在产生可归属的能力证据的同时,仍然提供超出静态基准的信息。 这些成果将不断演变的评价确立为与日益有能力、自我发展的力量相对应的实际评价。

blocks.en: Appendix A Core Taxonomies, Capability Rubrics, and System Boundary
blocks.zh: 附录A 核心分类、能力Rubrics和系统边界

blocks.en: This section defines the foundational taxonomies, ordinal capability rubrics, and invariance boundaries that anchor CUA-SEE across evolution rounds.
blocks.zh: 本节定义了基础分类法,正线能力路由法,以及将 CUA-SEE 锁定在进化回合的不变化边界.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 11 , we organize the feature space as a four-level hierarchy spanning software, feature families, functional categories, and concrete operations. The representative branches illustrate how application-level functionality is decomposed into directly executable and verifiable actions across browsers, productivity tools, creative applications, diagram editors, and media players. This structured taxonomy provides a consistent basis for measuring feature coverage, identifying underexplored functionality, and guiding task evolution toward broader and more diverse interaction capabilities.
blocks.zh: 如图11所示,我们把功能空间组织成一个四级层次的软件、功能类和具体操作。 代表性分支说明应用程序级功能如何分解为浏览器,生产力工具,创造性应用程序,图表编辑器和媒体播放器之间的可直接执行和可核查的行动. 这种结构化的分类学为测量地物覆盖范围,确定未充分探索的功能,指导任务向更广泛和更多样化的互动能力的演变提供了一致的基础.

blocks.en: Independent of software features, task demand is parameterized over seven orthogonal capability dimensions scored on an ordinal 0 0 – 5 5 rubric (Table 4 ). Scores are anchored in objective task factors—such as target count, value coupling, distractor similarity, state-derivation depth, and dependency chain length—derived strictly from the instruction, initial state, and verifier contract rather than predicted agent performance. To keep capability probes attributable, nuisance confounds ( step-budget ratio, context load, navigation hiddenness, and verifier risk ) are tracked separately and bounded during candidate selection.
blocks.zh: 任务需求独立于软件特点,在正数0至5分(表4)上得分的7个正向能力维度上参数化。 分数基于客观的任务因素——如目标计数、价值相接、分散注意力的相似性、国家开发深度和依赖链长度——严格从指令、初始状态和核查合同而不是从预计代理业绩中推导出来。 为了保持能力探测器的可归属性,在挑选候选人时分别跟踪并限定障碍因素(步骤预算比率、上下文载荷、导航隐蔽性和核查者风险)。

blocks.en: To characterize low-level GUI interaction demands without conflating them with cognitive capabilities, each evolved profile records required exposure over eight canonical action families: click , text entry , keyboard shortcut , menu navigation , dialog entry , numeric-widget manipulation , drag , and scroll . Action annotations represent task-required interaction exposure rather than trajectory-inferred behavior, ensuring that software–action profiles remain well-defined even when an agent fails early or chooses an alternative UI path.
blocks.zh: 要描述低水平的图形界面交互需求,而不将其与认知能力混为一谈,每个已演化的剖面记录都需要在8个犬类动作家族中曝光:点击、文本条目、键盘快捷键、菜单导航、对话框条目、数字widget操纵、拖放和滚动。 动作说明代表了任务要求的交互曝光,而不是由轨迹推导的行为,确保软件–动作配置仍然清晰地定义,即使一个代理器提前失败或选择了另一个UI路径.

blocks.en: Table 4 : Seven calibrated capability dimensions, grounded task factors, and condensed 0 0 – 5 5 ordinal intensity anchors.
blocks.zh: 表4:7个校正能力维度,基于任务因子,并收缩了0–5个正弦强度锚.

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Feature taxonomy hierarchy tree. Software functionality is organized into four levels—feature family, category, and concrete operation beneath each application—with representative branches shown for diverse software. The feature-, family-, category-, and operation-level coverage metrics reported in the main text are computed over this hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 图11:地貌分类分层树. 软件功能分为四个层次——每个应用程序下的特点家族、类别和具体操作,并显示各种软件的代表性分支。 主文中报告的特征、家庭、类别和业务层面的覆盖度衡量标准是按这一等级计算的。

blocks.en: To clarify what “self-evolving” entails and why cross-round comparison remains stable, Table 5 separates CUA-SEE’s invariant infrastructure from its round-wise generated artifacts. Holding the VM substrate, native state adapters, taxonomies, scoring rubrics, and validation gates fixed ensures that changes across rounds reflect genuine growth in task scope, boundary resolution, and contract coverage rather than shifting measurement standards.
blocks.zh: 为了澄清 " 自演 " 意味着什么,以及为什么横轮比较保持稳定,表5将CUA-SEE的不稳定基础设施与其圆相生成的文物区分开来。 拥有VM底盘、本土状态适配器、分类学、分数分数分数和固定的验证门,可确保各轮变化反映任务范围、边界分辨率和合同范围的真正增长,而不是改变计量标准。

blocks.en: B.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: B.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate benchmark evolution and diagnostic evolution on realistic Ubuntu desktop environments derived from OSWorld. As shown in Figure 1 and Figure 3 , CUA-SEE’s shared measurement substrate expands the eight core OSWorld applications (Chrome, GIMP, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, LibreOffice Writer, Thunderbird, VLC, and Visual Studio Code) with twelve additional native- CanonicalState -instrumented desktop environments—Blender, VSCodium, JupyterLab, Krita, Draw.io, SMPlayer, OBS Studio, ONLYOFFICE, OpenScreen, ComfyUI, Zotero, and Brave—bringing total software breadth to 20 applications across browsers, office suites, IDEs, creative/3D studios, diagramming, media production, and research workflows. To ensure strict task-lineage correspondence with the original R ​ 0 R0 benchmark without confounding cross-round metrics with newly introduced software domains, the longitudinal multi-round panel ( R ​ 0 R0 – R ​ 4 R4 ) and diagnostic matrices ( R ​ 0 R0 – R ​ 3 R3 ) track the eight core OSWorld applications, while the full 20-application substrate supports broader benchmark synthesis and scope expansion. Benchmark evolution is evaluated on a heterogeneous panel of five computer-use agents: Kimi-K2.6, Seed-2.1-Pro, Gemini-3.5-Flash, Qwen-3.7-Plus, and GPT-5.5. Diagnostic evolution focuses on three representative agents—Kimi-K2.6, Seed-2.1-Pro, and Gemini-3.5-Flash—because it constructs a separate, agent-conditional task sequence for each target agent.
blocks.zh: 我们评价从OSWorld衍生出的现实的Ubuntu桌面环境的基准演化和诊断演化. 如图1和图3所示,CUA-SEE共享的测量底板将OSWorld的8个核心应用(Chrome、GIMP、LibreOffice Calc、LibreOffice Impress、LibreOffice Writer、Thunebird、VLC和Visual Studio代码)扩展,新增了12个本地的-Canonical State-设备化的桌面环境-Blender、VSCodium、JupyterLab、Krita、Draw.io、SMPlayer、OBS Studio、OnlyOFFICE、OpenScreen、ComfyUI、Zotero,以及勇敢的软件全宽度扩展到20个跨浏览器、办公套件、IDes、创造性的3D工作室、图表绘制、媒体制作和研究工作流程。 为确保严格的任务行距对应原R 0 R0基准,而不会将跨回合的度量衡与新引入的软件域相混淆,纵向多回合面板(R 0 R0 – R 4 R4)和诊断矩阵(R 0 R0 – R 3 R3)跟踪8个核心OSWorld应用,而完整的20应用底板则支持更广泛的基准合成和范围扩展. 由5个计算机使用代理人组成的不同小组评估基准的演变情况: Kimi-K2.6,种子2.1-Pro,双子座3.5-Flash,Quen-3.7-Plus,和GPT-5.5. 诊断演化侧重于三种具有代表性的物剂——Kimi-K2.6、种子-2.1-Pro和双子座-3.5-Flash——因为它为每个目标物剂构建了单独的、具有物剂条件的任务序列。

blocks.en: We start from a fixed panel of 100 OSWorld task lineages and evolve each lineage for four rounds, producing the original benchmark R ​ 0 R0 and evolved suites R ​ 1 R1 – R ​ 4 R4 . Every round retains the same 100 lineage identifiers and is evaluated by all five agents, yielding 500 task–agent observations per round and 2,500 observations over the complete trajectory. This paired design prevents changes in aggregate performance from being attributed to a changing task sample. Each evolved task is also annotated with a seven-dimensional capability-demand vector on a 0–5 scale and with exact software–taxonomy–operation cells, enabling difficulty and coverage to be measured independently.
blocks.zh: 我们从一个由100个OSWorld任务线组成的固定面板开始,并进化出每个分线四轮,产生原始的基准R 0 R0并进化出R 1 R1 – R 4 R4. 每轮都保留同样的100个分界线识别器,并由所有5个代理人进行评估,得出每轮500个任务 - 代理观测结果和2 500个完整的轨迹观测结果。 这种配对设计可以防止聚合性能的变化被归为不断变化的任务样本. 每项演化后的任务还附有一个0至5级的七维能力需求向量,并附有精确的软件-分类-操作单元格,从而能够独立地衡量难度和覆盖范围。

blocks.en: Diagnostic evolution is run independently for each target agent. The current experiment contains four 100-task rounds for Kimi and three 100-task rounds each for Seed and Gemini, for a total of 1,000 evolved task profiles. The primary diagnostic matrices pool a matched 100-task R ​ 0 R0 baseline with R ​ 1 R1 – R ​ 3 R3 for each agent, yielding 1,200 planned agent–task–round slots before rollout availability and validity filtering. Kimi R ​ 4 R4 is included only in task-generation and verifier analyses because it is outside the R ​ 0 R0 – R ​ 3 R3 matrix scope. Profiles without eligible rollouts are retained as missing or unavailable evidence rather than imputed as failure.
blocks.zh: 诊断演化是针对每个目标剂独立运行的. 目前的实验包含为Kimi提供4个100任务回合,为种子和双子座各提供3个100任务回合,共计1000个演化出的任务简介. 初级诊断矩阵集合了一个匹配的100任务R 0 R0基线和R 1 R1 – R 3 R3每种剂,在推出可用性和有效性过滤之前产生1,200个计划剂-任务-圆槽. Kimi R 4 R4只包含在任务生成和验证分析中,因为它在R 0 R0 – R 3 R3矩阵范围之外. 不具备合格推出条件的描述图被保留为缺失或没有证据,而不是被归为失败。

blocks.en: Each episode is limited to 50 environment-interaction steps. The environment records the complete action trajectory, the terminal normalized task score, and state-hook checkpoint traces. We classify scores of at least 0.99 0.99 as pass and scores of at most 0.01 0.01 as fail; intermediate scores retain partial credit. A zero-score episode that reaches the 50-step limit is classified as censored rather than as clean failure. Unless otherwise stated, partially observable but sound verifiers are retained and their uncovered requirements are reported explicitly; the stricter full-verifier-only filter is used only in designated sensitivity analyses. For retried executions, aggregation selects the latest completed run within each published task instance.

blocks.en: Task synthesis, verifier construction, and result aggregation are executed on two CPU servers. The primary OSW server runs Ubuntu 22.04 with 96 Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 vCPUs and 376 GiB RAM; the auxiliary SCI server runs Ubuntu 20.04 with 256 AMD EPYC 7T83 vCPUs and 1008 GiB RAM. Neither server uses a local GPU because model inference is provided by remote Codex subscription or API services. Evolved task JSON files, dataset manifests, and executable verifiers are published, whose rollout controller runs on the OSW server at http://localhost:8086 . The controller launches isolated Ubuntu desktop environments, applies task setup, executes the selected agent, invokes the state-hook verifier after interaction steps, and stores traj.json , checkpoints.jsonl , and result.txt for subsequent analysis.

blocks.en: B.2 Implementation

blocks.en: Our implementation represents each methodological component as a versioned Codex skill rather than as an unconstrained one-shot prompt. The benchmark evolver consumes aligned multi-agent trajectories and the shared coverage registry; the diagnostic batch planner converts longitudinal evidence into a round-level dispatch; the diagnostic task evolver realizes one controlled probe per dispatch row; and the verifier evolver reconstructs and validates the corresponding executable measurement contract. Every worker is instructed to read the relevant skill specification and schema before accessing task artifacts. Thus, capability rubrics, admissible evolution operators, confound limits, output schemas, and validation gates remain fixed across parallel workers and rounds.
blocks.zh: 我们的实施工作代表着每一个方法部分,作为版本的Codex技能,而不是不加限制的一发快取。 基准演化器消耗了一致的多剂轨迹和共享的覆盖登记;诊断批量规划器将纵向证据转换为圆平面调度;诊断任务演化器实现每个调度行一个可控探测器;验证器演化器重建和验证相应的可执行测量合同. 要求每个工人在访问任务文物之前先阅读相关的技能规格和计划。 因此,能力分数、可接受演化操作器、混淆的限度、输出计划以及验证门仍然固定在平行工人和轮子之间。

blocks.en: Batch analysis is performed once before each diagnostic round, after which independent task workers consume the resulting dispatch.jsonl in parallel. Benchmark tasks and task-specific verifiers are parallelized similarly, while shared feature and capability registries use atomic claims to prevent duplicated coverage gains. The reusable runners default to three concurrent Codex workers, a two-second launch stagger, a 45-minute per-task timeout, and resumable execution that skips already validated terminal artifacts; bounded repair and verifier jobs may raise concurrency to ten. Machine-readable run summaries record task status, duration, token usage, retries, validation errors, and the exact output directory.

blocks.en: We use GPT-5.5 for task and verifier synthesis and explicitly set reasoning effort to high for the reported runs. Workloads are distributed across two isolated execution modes: a ChatGPT/Codex subscription backend authenticated through a persistent CODEX_HOME , and an API backend using an OpenAI-compatible Responses interface through Routify. A worker uses exactly one backend; credentials and provider-specific environment variables from the other backend are removed, and there is no silent cross-backend fallback. This hybrid deployment allows subscription and API capacity to be combined at the campaign level without changing the skill, prompt contract, model identifier, or output schema.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-5.5进行任务和核查综合,并明确为报告的运行设定高度推理。 工作负荷分布在两个孤立的执行模式中:一个通过持续的CODEXHOME认证的ChatGPT/Codex订阅后端,另一个通过Routify使用OpenAI兼容的响应界面的API后端. 一个工人完全使用一个后端;从另一个后端删除证书和提供者特有的环境变量,没有静默的交叉后端倒置. 这种混合部署可以使订阅和API能力在运动层面合并,而不会改变技能,即时合同,模型标识符,或输出计划.

blocks.en: Task workers must produce structured task, capability-profile, analysis, and task-card artifacts, all of which pass schema and semantic consistency checks before entering a round. Verifier workers additionally run syntax, interface-contract, schema-grounding, PRE/PASS discrimination, and negative-fixture checks before a task is marked rollout-ready. Source identifiers, lineage operations, model/backend settings, token accounting, and rollout paths are preserved in machine-readable summaries. This artifact-first design makes every plotted value traceable to a task profile, one selected rollout, and one validated verifier.

A task contributes to every positive capability demand recorded in its profile, using the same primary/supporting attribution rule as the capability–intensity matrix. The value therefore summarizes performance on tasks coupling a particular application with a particular capability demand. It is not a software-only score and does not imply that failures are uniquely caused by that capability.
blocks.zh: 行是应用程序,列是能力维度. 一项任务有助于满足其概况中记录的每一项积极能力需求,采用与能力强度矩阵相同的主要/支助归属规则。 因此,该值总结了将特定应用程序与特定能力需求相配合的任务的业绩。 它不单单是软件得分,也不意味着失败是这种能力造成的。

blocks.en: Each row is an application and each cell corresponds to one top-level taxonomy feature family required by at least one profile. All required features are included, with primary and supporting roles weighted equally; leaf operations are collapsed to the top-level family only for readability. The printed percentage is the rounded mean checkpoint score over clean tasks exposing that software–family pair. A task requiring multiple feature families contributes its episode score to each corresponding cell.
blocks.zh: 每个行是一个应用程序,每个单元格对应至少一个剖面需要的一个顶级分类特征家族. 所有必需的特性都包括在内,主要角色和辅助角色的加权均匀;叶片操作被倒塌到顶层家庭,只有可读性。 印出的百分比是四舍五入的平均检查点得分, 一个需要多个故事家庭的任务为每个对应的细胞贡献出其插曲分数.

blocks.en: Columns represent required interaction families such as click, type, shortcut, menu navigation, dialog entry, numeric-widget manipulation, drag, and scroll. The matrix records planned action exposure from the task profile, not actions inferred from a trajectory. Its color is the mean whole-task checkpoint score for tasks requiring that action family; it is therefore not an action-localized success rate. One task may contribute to several action columns, and R ​ 0 R0 contributes no action cells because the original tasks do not have compatible action-exposure annotations.
blocks.zh: 列代表了所需的交互家族,如点击,键入,快捷键,菜单导航,对话框条目,数字-widget操作,拖放和滚动等. 矩阵记录了任务简介中计划采取的行动,而不是根据轨迹推断的行动。 它的颜色是需要行动家族的任务的平均全任务检查站分数;因此它不是一个行动本地化的成功率. 一个任务可能有助于多个动作列,而R 0 R0则不贡献动作单元格,因为原始任务没有相容的动作-曝光说明.

blocks.en: In the compact paper matrices, a gray cell means that no eligible clean score is available; it may be genuinely unexposed or may have planned profiles whose rollouts are censored, confounded, invalid, or missing. The annotated companion plots separate these cases: P P is the number of designed profiles assigned to a cell, V V is the number of clean rollout observations, gray denotes P = 0 P=0 , and light blue denotes P > 0 P>0 but V = 0 V=0 . We additionally report three coverage layers. Exposed means that at least one task profile occupies the cell, valid means that at least one clean observation occupies it, and well-sampled requires at least three clean observations drawn from at least two distinct base-task families.
blocks.zh: 在紧凑的纸质矩阵中,灰色单元格意味着没有合格的干净分数;它可能真正没有暴露,或可能已经规划过其推出经过审查、令人困惑、无效或缺失的简介。 附加说明的相伴图将这些情况分开:P是指定给一个单元格的被设计剖面图的数量;V V是清洁放出观测数据的数量;灰色表示P=0 P=0;而浅蓝色表示P > 0 P>0,但V=0 V=0. 我们还报告三个覆盖层。 被曝光意味着至少有一个任务剖面占据了细胞,有效意味着至少有一个干净的观察占据了它,经过很好的取样,至少需要从至少两个不同的基础任务家族中抽取出三个干净的观察.

blocks.en: The original OSWorld tasks were not authored with diagnostic primary-dimension or action labels. For each agent, the R ​ 0 R0 capability axis is reconstructed from the one-to-one R ​ 1 R1 profile: we use the dimension selected as the R ​ 1 R1 primary probe and that task’s recorded source-demand intensity. The full source-demand vector supplies supporting dimensions, while feature cells come from the curated R ​ 0 R0 taxonomy sidecar. This produces a matched baseline with one observation per lineage, but it should not be interpreted as an independently annotated R ​ 0 R0 diagnostic plan. No R ​ 0 R0 action matrix is reconstructed.
blocks.zh: 最初的OSWorld任务并没有以诊断初级分化或动作标签编写. 对每种剂来说,R 0 R0能力轴是从一对一的R 1 R1配置重建而来:我们使用所选择的维度作为R 1 R1主探测器,以及该任务记录的源-需求强度. 完整的源-需求向量提供支撑维度,而特征细胞则来自被曲解的R 0 R0分类辅助车. 这产生了一个匹配的基准,每个分系都有一个观测结果,但不应将其解释为一个独立附加说明的R 0 R0诊断计划. 没有重建 R 0 R0 动作矩阵 。

blocks.en: The separate diagnostic-resolution plots use manual task-level judgments and explicitly exclude checkpoint scores. Only judgments marked eligible for capability analysis are included. Boundary-region density is the fraction of scores strictly between 20 and 80. Upward-probe transition yield is the fraction of clean-pass source tasks whose higher-intensity successors become partial or fail. A strict empirical boundary bracket occurs when an upward probe changes pass to partial/fail or a downward probe changes partial/fail to pass; bracket width is the absolute difference between the two capability intensities, and a width-one event localizes the boundary to adjacent levels. These quantities evaluate adaptive resolution rather than overall task difficulty.
blocks.zh: 单独的诊断解析地块采用人工任务级判断,并明确排除了检查站分数. 仅列入标有能力分析条件的判决。 边界-区域密度是严格在20到80之间得分的分数. 向上-向上过渡收益率是清洁通道源任务的一小部分,其较高强度的接班人成为部分或失败. 当向上探测器改变为局部/故障或向下探测器改变为局部/未能通过时,会出现严格的实证边界括号;括号宽度是两种能力强度的绝对差,而宽度-一事件将边界定位到相邻的地平面. 这些数量评估的是适应性分辨率,而不是总体任务难度。

blocks.en: Requirement coverage is the number of atomic task requirements grounded in executable checkpoints divided by the total number of extracted requirements. A Full verifier covers every requirement, whereas a Partial verifier preserves a nonempty sound observable subset and records the remaining gaps; Blocked tasks have no meaningful observable checkpoint and are not rolled out. Checkpoint count is the number of callable checkpoint functions and is reported both as a total and as a per-task mean. READY indicates that the verifier passed syntax, interface-contract, schema-grounding, and static validation gates; it is an implementation-validity status, while empirical PRE/PASS and negative-fixture tests provide the behavioral discrimination evidence.
blocks.zh: 要求涵盖的范围是可执行检查站规定的原子任务要求数量,除以提取要求的总数。 完全核查人涵盖每一项要求,而部分核查人保留非空声可观测子集并记录所剩空白; 被封锁的任务没有有意义的可观测检查站,没有推出。 检查站计数是可调用检查站功能的数量,既报告为总数也报告为每个任务平均值. READY表示,验证员通过语法,界面合同,计程和静态验证门;这是一种执行-有效性状态,而经验性PRE/PASS和负固定测试提供了行为歧视证据.

blocks.en: For paired R ​ 0 R0 – R ​ 4 R4 benchmark comparisons, confidence intervals are obtained by 5,000 task-level bootstrap resamples. Intervals for changes resample paired per-task differences, preserving lineage correspondence across rounds. Diagnostic matrices report cell means together with evidence counts or evidence-maturity layers rather than confidence intervals because many cells are intentionally sparse during adaptive exploration.
blocks.zh: 对于配对的R 0 R0 – R 4 R4基准比较,信心间隔由5000个任务级的靴子回样得到. 用于修改的间距重取每任务差异的对称,保存跨回合的分行对应. 诊断矩阵报告细胞是指与证据计数或证据成熟层一起,而不是置信间隔,因为许多细胞在适应性探索中是故意地稀少的.
